svg.title: VACUUM: physical cleanup, isolated
svg.desc: Before: Delta version 2, where earlier OPTIMIZE and PURGE commits tombstoned A, B, C and D. delta-maintenance vacuum deletes those blobs and writes no commit. Afterwards Kusto did not reread the active files G, E and F.
svg.text: VACUUM writes no commit. It only deletes blobs that earlier commits already removed.
adds A, B, C, D, E, F

text.tspan: → deletes tombstoned blobs, writes no commit

svg.text: adds A, B, C, D, E, F
no new commit: the log did not change
Isolated VACUUM (run 7): 0 of 3 and 0 of 8 unchanged files reread, in 4 of 4 trials, 0 regressions.
The tombstones were made before QAP was enabled. Run 6a made them after, and got a false alarm (3 of 8).
tombstoned (gone from the log, still on disk)
